resources.string: View, edit, and share plain text and Markdown on Android.
No app could open the source-code link. You can copy it below.
Open files stay with the storage provider you choose. Compatible files save automatically after edits. New and received text remains in memory until you choose Save.

BeauTyXT keeps no app-private document copies or recovery files. Undo history is kept only for the current session. Unsaved content is lost if Android ends the app process. Your selected storage provider may still sync its files.
Text parsing, Markdown preview, and QR and NFC validation run on this device. BeauTyXT has no Internet permission and does not run scripts or fetch document images.

BeauTyXT supports UTF-8 plain text and Markdown files up to 256 MiB. Markdown previews are limited to 16 MiB, QR transfers to 1,536 UTF-8 bytes, and complete NFC messages to 256 KiB. Printing can use source text or formatted Markdown.
